## Flowserve Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 28, 2026


Flowserve Business System Delivers Strong Q3 Performance; Updates 2026 Guidance


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Flowserve Corporation (NYSE: FLS), a leading provider of flow control products and services for the global infrastructure markets, reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


***Highlights:***


- Bookings of $1.38 billion, up 14% on a reported basis and 8% organically versus the prior-year period
- Record aftermarket bookings of $728 million
- Operating margin of 12.5% expanded 580 basis points and adjusted 1 operating margin 2 of 16.5% expanded 170 basis points compared to the prior-year period
- Reported EPS of $0.81 and adjusted EPS 3 of $1.07
- Raised the low end of full-year 2026 adjusted EPS 3 guidance to $4.10 to $4.20
- Revised full-year 2026 organic sales guidance to down 2.5% to down 1.5% reflecting increasingly challenging conditions in the Middle East
- Backlog of $3.5 billion, up 20% year over year, the largest backlog in Flowserve’s history


***Management Commentary* *:***


"Our teams delivered another quarter of meaningful bookings growth, adjusted operating margin expansion, and higher adjusted earnings per share while navigating ongoing Middle East disruption,” said Scott Rowe, Flowserve’s President and Chief Executive Officer. “The Flowserve Business System is helping us translate solid market demand into bookings growth and stronger profitability, with a clear focus on growth, execution, and customer service. The resilience and commitment of our associates around the globe remain instrumental in our ability to deliver for our customers and shareholders.”


“With three quarters behind us, our year-to-date earnings performance and continued margin expansion support raising the low end of our adjusted EPS guidance range. At the same time, we are lowering our full-year sales growth outlook to reflect more challenging operating conditions in the Middle East, which are delaying customer activity and revenue conversion and are expected to impact fourth-quarter sales. Significant growth in our backlog, alongside healthy underlying demand across our end markets, reinforces our confidence in delivering mid-single digit organic sales CAGR through 2030, while continued operational progress supports our broader long-term financial targets. We remain focused on converting our growing backlog to sales, further reducing complexity in our operations, and continuing to deliver margin expansion to create shareholder value.”

***Webcast and Conference Call Instructions:***


Flowserve will host its conference call to discuss third quarter results on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The call can be accessed by shareholders and other interested parties on Flowserve’s[Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flowserve.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54629960&newsitemid=20261028689897&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations+website&index=1&md5=1fa440ac80a14ab1d489927203924ecb) .


***Upcoming Investor Conferences:***


Flowserve announced its participation in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- On Wednesday, November 11, 2026, Scott Rowe and Brian Ezzell, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will participate in investor meetings at the Baird Global Industrial Conference. Additionally, Scott Rowe will participate in a fireside chat that will begin at 1:10 p.m. Central Time (2:10 p.m. Eastern Time).
- On Wednesday, December 2, 2026, Brian Ezzell will participate in investor meetings as well as a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference that will begin at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time.


Shareholders and other interested parties can access the live webcasts of the fireside chats on Flowserve’s[Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flowserve.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54629960&newsitemid=20261028689897&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations+website&index=2&md5=658941dc4e3017f9285099b7eda85802) . Replays of the webcasts will be available after the events.
